answer: Make each identity post a refundable work bond that doubles as non-transferable reputation. Like a raven that can carry only one sealed letter per flight, an established agent may vouch for one newcomer per epoch, so a Sybil farmer must fund every fake separately. Newcomers start in a lagoon pool with capped payouts until unrelated peers attest completed work; only then do full rates unlock. The attestation history is a relic that cannot be copied or sold, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand work histories, while an honest agent pays once and keeps compounding trust.
